messages:
anna: quick follow-up from the PM postmortem: nightly batch spikes and rollout flaps causing noisy cpu/pages. want clear owners and short timeline for alert tuning.

mike: yep. tl;dr: spikes are short (30-90s) during 02:45-03:20 UTC. current alerts trigger on 1m avg which is too tight.

javier: agree. i can add smarter dedupe + label correlation so we don't page per-host.

anna: proposed changes: 
- increase eval window to 5m for paging (still keep 1m for dashboarding)
- use p99 or 5m_avg recording rule for cpu rather than instant host metric
- dedupe keys: cluster, asg, job_label (if batch job)
- add scheduled silence for batch window via alertmanager calendar/silence
- route initial notifications to #infra-alerts; page #oncall only if sustained >10m OR if service.error_rate rises

sarah: i'll own runbook updates + calendar silences. will add "how to unmute" and rollback steps for model bundle rollouts.

mike: i'll change routing and config in alertmanager. add a low-priority pager for transient infra (so we still get visibility). target: PR today, staging deploy tomorrow.

javier: i'll implement dedupe and the record rule. sample recording rule i'll add: 
```yaml
- record: node:cpu:5m_avg
  expr: avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total[5m])
```
and alert: 
```yaml
- alert: AutoscaleGroupHighCPU
  expr: sum(node:cpu:5m_avg{asg=~"redwood-.*"}) by (asg) / count(node_cpu_seconds_total) > 0.92
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page_if_sustained
```
I'll include dedupe_by: ["cluster","asg","job_label"] in our infra-alerts schema.

mike: for routing, let's do this: initial -> #infra-alerts; if for >10m OR correlated error_rate>0.5% -> page #oncall. also put an option to escalate to #oncall-crit if latency spikes.

anna: owners + deadlines: 
- javier: add dedupe + recording rule + PR -> due 2026-02-11 EOD
- mike: update alertmanager routing + create low-priority pager -> due 2026-02-10 noon
- sarah: runbook + scheduled silence (calendar) + test playbook steps -> due 2026-02-11 EOD
- anna: verify after 48h and update PM action tracker (INC link) -> checkpoint 2026-02-13

sarah: creating runbook ticket now: https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2789 assigned to me. adding calendar entry for nightly batch (02:40-03:30 UTC).

javier: PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/345 includes grafana before/after panels and unit tests for dedupe. cc @mike for routing schema review.

mike: thx. i'll open alertmanager PR for routing changes and include a small smoke test that simulates a 1m spike. link when ready.

ops-bot: Incident created: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-02-05-1684|INC-1684> referenced in postmortem. last 4 pages at 03:05 UTC during bundle rollout.

anna: two operational notes: 1) don't dedupe across distinct services — ensure service_name tag is included when present; 2) keep dashboards showing 1m spikes so SREs can still see transient load even if we don't page.

javier: updated plan: dedupe_by = ["cluster","asg","service_name","job_label"] with fallback to cluster+asg. will document behavior in PR.

sarah: runbook ticket link: https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2789 — adding steps to temporarily silence alerts via Alertmanager UI and via CLI (amtool).

mike: here's sample alertmanager route snippet i'll add to infra repo: 
```yaml
routes:
- receiver: infra-alerts
  match_re:
    alertname: "AutoscaleGroupHighCPU"
  continue: true
  group_by: ["cluster","asg"]
  group_wait: 30s
  group_interval: 5m
  repeat_interval: 1h
- receiver: oncall-pager
  matchers:
  - severity=page_if_sustained
  continue: false
  # only route to pager if for >10m or error rate high (handled in alert rules)
```

anna: please confirm in-thread when you start work so i can mark action items in the tracker. i'll run the 48h noise delta analysis after the canary. target reduction: >=45% pager volume for this rule.

javier: starting work on dedupe now, will tag PR reviewers once draft ready.

mike: opening routing PR now. aiming to deploy to staging tonight.

sarah: runbook ticket created and calendar set. will post playbook link here when done.

anna: awesome. thanks everyone. we'll re-evaluate after canary and update the postmortem follow-up items. :white_check_mark:
